scope: Deterministic Feishu interactive-card post-ingest analysis authorization in the existing single group and single consumer.
blocker: OpenClaw core receives card.action.trigger but routes project-unknown actions through synthetic commands; no Feishu-specific direct plugin handler dispatch is wired. A project card handler therefore cannot be proven without core change, competing consumer, or an unapproved replacement transport.
admin_prerequisite: Verify or enable card.action.trigger on the existing zhongshu Feishu App using its current WebSocket subscription, without adding a second im.message.receive_v1 subscription.
required_user_decision: Authorize an exact project-side write scope only if Jovi accepts a supported deterministic handler integration path that does not violate the single-consumer and no-core-change rules.
stop_boundary: No production apply, Gateway restart, real attachment, card send, callback test, R4/R5, final P0 Gate, or P1.
